messages:
Li Wei: quick heads-up — q5 quant bringup for `veridian-lite` shows ~5 BLEU drop on zh->en dev set compared to float baseline. seems localized to lines with ZWJ/soft-space behavior (emoji/ruby combos).
Maya: can you paste a minimal repro?
Li Wei: yup — here's a failing pair from the eval set:
Li Wei: ```
SRC: 我喜欢这本书‍📖
REF: I love this book.
PRED(float): I love this book.
PRED(q5): I love this  book.
```
Li Wei: note extra ASCII space before 'book' in q5 output (double space). not every ZWJ triggers it, seems tied to token boundary around emoji + han.
Sanjay: weird — could be tokenization merge/split causing an extra literal space during detok. did we change `detok` normalization in the q5 runtime?
Emilia: also check whether the quantized tokenizer table altered the joiner token id mapping. small id shift -> wrong joiner handling. run `compare_vocab.sh`? :eyes:
Li Wei: ran vocab diffs earlier, no global shift, but some indices map to ASCII space in the q5 tokenmap produced by our conversion script. suspect bug in `convert_tokenmap.py` for q5 path.
Maya: can you run token-level alignment for that example? `python -m tools.token_align --src examples/zwj_short.txt --model veridian-q5` and paste the alignment.
Li Wei: ran it, snippet below:
Li Wei: ```
TOKS(float): ["我","喜欢","这本","书","‍","📖"]
TOKS(q5): ["我","喜欢","这本","书"," ","📖"]
```
Li Wei: q5 token sequence has a literal space token instead of ZWJ token id. explains the extra space.
Sanjay: OK confirms convert script bug. I pushed a quick patch idea to `eng-ml/convert-q5-tokenmap` but want to run the full eval before merging. can we bisect?
Emilia: CI Bot kicked off an eval job: <https://ci.redwood/testruns/4998887810|veridian-q5-eval-zwj-batch>. current run shows BLEU drop reproduces on 1k sample subset.
CI Bot: job started by Emilia — veridian-q5-eval-zwj-batch — status: queued -> running.
Maya: plan: 1) Li Wei will regenerate tokenmap with changed conversion logic and run `token_align` across 10K samples; 2) Sanjay will run A/B eval (float vs q5-fixed) on patched tokenmap; 3) I'll open a rollback PR if other regressions appear.
Li Wei: started tokenmap regen locally, will post diff and sample alignments in this thread when ready.
Sanjay: if patch looks safe, we should also add a unit test covering ZWJ/emoji to tokenmap conversion to avoid regression.
Emilia: also add a metric to the eval harness that flags detok whitespace diffs around CJK-emoji boundaries (simple regex + token compare). we missed this earlier.
Maya: agreed. assign tasks: Li Wei -> regen + sample eval; Sanjay -> CI A/B and tests; Emilia -> harness flag. I'll coordinate PR reviews.
Li Wei: initial regen diff: one-line change in `convert_tokenmap.py` to preserve control char ids instead of folding to ascii space. patch looks small, pushing branch now.
CI Bot: veridian-q5-eval-zwj-batch job finished — status: failed (BLEU delta: -4.9) — logs uploaded: <https://ci.redwood/logs/4998887810>.
Maya: thanks — let's keep thread for updates. if patch fixes it, we schedule a canary for dedicated clusters before full rollout. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: noted, I'll add the unit test and a short doc blurb about tokenmap invariants.
Emilia: posting quick checklist for postmortem if needed: reproduce, bisect, patch, unit test, add eval flag, canary.
Li Wei: will post alignment + PR link in ~30m.
Maya: thanks everyone — good catch on the tokenmap corner case.
